cam: Heads-up: PrismPay reported 502 spikes from dedicated-pool-3 after today's canary (09:10 UTC). CSM escalated — P1. Need owners + workaround timeline.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to dedicated-pool-3 by jaya at 2790123400. traffic shift observed at 09:12. status: success

jaya: looking now. runtime logs show upstream 502 and 'kv cache miss OOM' in runtime v0.54.7. planning rollback to v0.54.5 in ~10m unless we patch quickly.

evelyn: can you paste a sample log + trace id from the customer?

cam: CSM provided trace id abc123-def. repro they ran:
```bash
curl -v -H 'x-request-id: abc123-def' https://prismpay.api.redwood/v1/generate
# ...
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
x-request-id: abc123-def
```

mike: @sre-oncall any infra signals? p99 for pool-3 jumped, then 5xxs.

sre-oncall: no network flapping. metrics show multiple KV cache evictions + OOM logs in runtime. suspect kernel selection regression causing memory pressure.

jaya: I'll revert pool-3 to runtime v0.54.5 now. Revert ETA ~8m. Hotfix (memory accounting change) ETA 4-6h, needs eng-ml review.

li: I'll review once the PR is up. If it's a small allocation tweak I can approve in ~1h. Ask jaya to include a small regression test for kv cache behavior.

evelyn: Ownership ask: revert = jaya, patch PR = jaya, review = li, release coordination = cam. Can we confirm those commits to customer?

cam: Confirmed. Plan: revert immediate (jaya), PR within 90m, li review 1h, canary hotfix staged later today (~4-6h). @ops-bot please open an incident ticket and set priority P1.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2029 - PrismPay dedicated 502s. Priority: P1. https://redwood/incidents/INC-2029

mike: I'll add postmortem template + runbook steps. Also will notify support to update the customer timeline: rollback done, hotfix ETA 4-6h.

cam: :thumbsup: follow-ups: jaya confirm revert here, li flag any blockers in the PR, sre-oncall monitor p99 and 5xx rate for next 30m.
